title: Native shortcode bytes and structural sibling ordinals survive quickstart editorial and cached replay
steps: Run the three declared Node test suites.
expect: Only ranges inside valid parsed core shortcode blocks are trusted technical content; their original bytes remain unchanged.
A complete sibling group with the same DOM path and zero-padded sequential ordinals is preserved, excluding quantitative captions and declared numeric or metric fields.
Gap, duplicate, mixed padding and statistics are not inferred structural; model wire hashes remain unchanged.
fence: No hardcoded template classes or names; trusted technical evidence is non-enumerable and native bytes are never re-escaped.
